statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.Smooth (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) ∧ (KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f)) ∧ (KdVPlan.RealField f → KdVPlan.RealField (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f)) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.HB s (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.hn s f)
proof:
intro n f
have hm : ∀ s : ℝ, KdVPlan.MemH s (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) := by
  intro s
  apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.Icc (-(n : ℤ)) (n : ℤ))
  intro k hk
  have hn : ¬ |(k : ℝ)| ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    intro h
    have hl : -(n : ℤ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast (abs_le.mp h).1
    have hr : k ≤ (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast (abs_le.mp h).2
    exact hk (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hl, hr⟩)
  simp [KdVPlan.cutoff, hn]
refine ⟨fun m => hm m, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro hz
  simpa [KdVPlan.ZeroMean, KdVPlan.cutoff] using hz
· intro hr k
  simp only [KdVPlan.cutoff, Int.cast_neg, abs_neg]
  split_ifs <;> simp [hr k]
· intro s hf
  refine ⟨hm s, Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_⟩
  apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum _ (hm s) hf
  intro k
  have hw : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
  by_cases hk : |(k : ℝ)| ≤ (n : ℝ)
  · simp [KdVPlan.cutoff, hk]
  · simpa [KdVPlan.cutoff, hk] using mul_nonneg hw (sq_nonneg ‖f k‖)
